interpretation: Both complete unordered typed result multisets matched independently reconstructed rows from the 1,240 exact approved bodies, all of which were rehashed against their pinned plans before the comparison.

At this fixed graph snapshot, adding the selective category clause increased scan calls from 18 to 32 and shard requests from 273 to 287; result rows fell from 14 to 6. Median coordinator execution rose from 1,377 ms to 1,728 ms in these three warm serial samples.

This is a bounded, small sample, not p95/p99, capacity, or broad performance certification. The MCP response does not expose client round-trip timing or raw trace identifiers, so neither is claimed here.

The data snapshot and query work are hosted, but the read metrics are not comparable to the prior local Miniflare scale sample. They also provide no evidence resolving hosted batch 827's unknown delivery.
